summary_markdown:
Discussion focused on how to display traffic data in the dashboard, particularly for clients lacking machine learning (ML) data. [me] suggested showing classical traffic figures as a fallback method because it simplifies reporting and increases reliability. However, this approach contradicts the 'crash early' concept if predictive models fail.

An alternative suggestion was made: having someone run all clients through a model tailored specifically for Afe.

[unknown] clarified that there are two specific clients (Jcd citymedia) that should be handled differently, while the remaining clients should use the old method.
decisions: Two specific clients (Jcd citymedia) will be handled using a different method.
Remaining clients will continue to use the old reporting method.
